setup.fixed_feasible_anchor_pair: Fix a representable anchor pair (c,f), its unique hub z, and the implication graph D=D_{z,c,f}.

forced_R.theorem: v belongs to F_R iff v is assigned R in every feasible representation.
proof: If v is reachable from R0, every feasible implication-closed R-side containing R0 must contain v.
If v is not in F_R, the canonical bottom R_min=F_R is feasible and assigns v to L.

forced_L.theorem: v belongs to F_L iff v is assigned L in every feasible representation.
proof: If v can reach L0 and v were assigned R, implication closure would force a vertex of L0 into R, contradiction.
If v is not in F_L, the canonical top R_max=V\({z} union F_L) is feasible and assigns v to R.

flexible.theorem: v belongs to F_star iff v takes both values across valid representations.
witnesses: Bottom representation R_min=F_R assigns every v in F_star to L.
Top representation R_max=V\({z} union F_L) assigns every v in F_star to R.

flexible_scc_poset.SCC_contraction: Contract strongly connected components of D[F_star] to obtain a DAG H.
flexible_scc_poset.representation_map: Every feasible R-side is uniquely R=F_R union U, where U is a union of SCCs forming a successor-closed / upper set of H.
flexible_scc_poset.converse: Every upper set U of H yields a feasible R=F_R union U.
flexible_scc_poset.lattice_isomorphism: The exact-channel representation lattice is isomorphic to the upper-set lattice Up(H).

equivalent_conditions: The flexible SCC DAG H has no vertices.

SCC_semantics.statement: Vertices in one flexible SCC cannot be chosen independently: implication reachability both ways forces them to move together between L and R.
SCC_semantics.freedom_granularity: The atomic degrees of freedom are flexible SCCs, not individual vertices.

algorithmic_outputs.FLEXIBLE: Complement of {z} union FORCED_R union FORCED_L
algorithmic_outputs.complexity: O(n+m) for a fixed feasible anchor pair after D is constructed.
